name: Functional and Smart Textiles
description: Introduction to functional, smart and intelligent textiles; high performance fibers and composites; shape memory fibers and textiles; textiles for thermoregulation; textiles with special wettability; superhydrophobic and self-cleaning textiles; health and hygiene textiles; tissue engineering; color changing textiles; conductive fibers and textiles; textiles for energy harvesting; textiles for energy storage; textile based sensors; industry trends and future innovations such as AI and IoT in textiles; sustainability and ethical considerations.
